name: TRAVERSE
aliases: Testosterone Replacement Therapy for Assessment of Long-Term Vascular Events and Efficacy Response in Hypogonadal Men
question: Is transdermal testosterone cardiovascularly noninferior to placebo in symptomatic hypogonadal men with established or elevated cardiovascular risk?

design.population: Men aged 45–80 years with hypogonadal symptoms, two fasting testosterone concentrations below 300 ng/dL, and established cardiovascular disease or elevated cardiovascular risk were enrolled at 316 US sites.
design.description: Phase 4, multicenter, double-blind noninferiority randomized trial
design.locator: NEJM pp108–111, Methods and Patients; 5,246 randomization IDs, 5,204 unique participants in full analysis

verdictNote: MACE noninferiority met; nonfatal arrhythmia, atrial fibrillation, acute kidney injury, and pulmonary embolism occurred more often with testosterone.
takeaway: Daily 1.62% testosterone gel was noninferior to placebo gel for cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke over mean 33.0-month follow-up in symptomatic hypogonadal men with established or elevated cardiovascular risk (HR 0.96, 95% CI 0.78–1.17).
